hypothesis: A different spatial representation and explicit ratio-conditioned subject selection may address the historical B3 candidate ranking gap; larger capacity alone is not the hypothesis.
change: Qwen3.5-4B predicts one normalized free-axis center, replacing the learned spatial scorer; retain maximum legal window geometry.
expected_effect: A measurable alternative subject-choice behavior; improvement is unproven.
risk: Grounding error, center bias, prompt sensitivity, older exposed public sources, poor transfer to native portrait geometry and official joint metric.
control: Same decoded frame, target ratio, maximum window geometry and six-annotator GT; centered window control. This is not an aligned B3 comparison.
prompt_template: Choose the best crop for this video frame. The crop aspect ratio is {rw}:{rh}. Keep the main subject and important action visible. The crop uses the largest possible window inside the image, so only its {axis} position can change. Return exactly a JSON object with one number: {"center": 0.5}. center is the desired crop center along the {axis} axis in normalized original-image coordinates from 0 to 1. Return no explanation.
parse_failure: record invalid response and fall back to center; count failures in unconditional metrics
readout: mean annotator IoU, per-source delta vs center, valid parse rate, runtime and peak VRAM; four sources are engineering diagnostics, not statistical efficacy evidence
stop_rule: No official inference or package promotion from this pilot. Do not tune prompt on these labels. Require an aligned B3 comparator and broader native x/y public evidence before official candidate.
sampling_amendment: Before any prediction: original RV AVI symlinks are broken. Use cached named-frame PNG nearest to each preregistered fraction (tie earlier), record PNG SHA. No GT metric or generated response had been inspected.
